lesson_title: Mastering Advanced Spring Boot: Features & Best Practices
lesson_description: In this comprehensive lesson, students will delve into advanced features of Spring Boot including dependency management, configuration, and security. They will also learn about best practices for building robust and maintainable full-stack applications. Through hands-on practice, students will implement these features in a project.

subtopics.title: Advanced Dependency Management in Spring Boot
subtopics.description: Learn how to effectively manage dependencies in your Spring Boot projects. Explore advanced features like dependency versions, scope management, and how to handle transitive dependencies. Understand best practices for maintaining a clean and efficient dependency tree in your applications.

subtopics.title: Configuration Best Practices for Spring Boot Applications
subtopics.description: Discover how to configure your Spring Boot applications to meet the needs of your project. Learn about the configuration files (application.properties and application.yml), how to use profiles, and best practices for managing configuration settings. Understand how to leverage environment variables and external configuration sources.

subtopics.title: Securing Spring Boot Applications with OAuth2 and JWT
subtopics.description: Explore how to secure your Spring Boot applications using OAuth2 and JSON Web Tokens (JWT). Understand the principles of authentication and authorization in the context of Spring Security. Implement OAuth2 for authentication and JWT for secure communication between your application and clients. Learn about securing endpoints and handling security exceptions effectively.
